context_scope: The 40 paired records are training-only contextual-rule development references. They cannot estimate contextual holdout accuracy or add 40 NER samples.
execution_gates: qualified pinned model artifact and dependencies
actual model tokenizer and CPU resources
independent_reference_review: Open; any future score must retain silver-reference interpretation without independent verification.

partition_use.dev: choose model and hyperparameters; report silver agreement
partition_use.test: one final evaluation after selection; never tune, relabel for scores or fit weights
partition_use.train: fit weights and debug preprocessing only

primary_metric: Micro exact passage-relative start/end/type entity precision, recall and F1; a partial boundary or wrong type counts as a false positive and false negative.
reference_quality: AI-created silver; agreement with references, not human/gold accuracy
release_thresholds: Roadmap 90% precision/85% recall are unqualified proposals, not achieved results or an approval decision.
required_reporting: actual model-tokenizer alignment over unchanged passages
CPU latency peak memory and recorded device
secondary_metric: Place-span exact start/end agreement ignoring six fine classes; compare only LOC predictions from coarse candidates against all six place reference classes, with unmatched LOC predictions counted as false positives.
zero_denominators: Report undefined precision/recall as null with raw counts; do not silently claim perfect performance.
